case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the hotel's central location, views over the Rio Corgo, comfortable beds, working air conditioning and good Wi‑Fi; several also noted friendly staff and positive cleanliness or breakfast experiences. At the same time reviewers reported outdated, worn facilities, scarce lighting, poor soundproofing, limited breakfast variety, occasional inadequate cleaning (dust) and one report of nighttime disturbance by a group.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Immediate revenue-management review: audit pricing/channel mix, apply discounts, promote strengths, pursue groups, review rules.

priorities.area: Property condition / Capital works & room comfort
priorities.recommendation: Commission a rapid property condition audit, create a phased refurbishment plan; implement low cost mitigations.
Immediate deep-clean, audit processes/checklists, retrain or reassign teams, increase inspections, notify guests, track KPIs.

priorities.area: Room condition / property fabric (lighting, worn materials, general state)
priorities.recommendation: Inspect room and public finishes immediately; plan phased remediation, apply mitigations where feasible; avoid capex.

priorities.area: Breakfast offering (variety / showcase of regional products)
